effects.description:
When spawning: Acquire a defensive shield (durability: 20% of max HP).
While defensive shield is active, enemy attacks will reduce shield durability instead of HP, and it will inflict Stagger on the enemy who attacked you. (Excludes some attacks.)

skills.detail:
Puts the character in Sparking state.
While in Sparking state, ATK is increased for Normal Attacks and the character cannot be Staggered and gains Status Effect Nullification.
Also deals a mid-range multiple hit attack with a Knockback effect.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Sparking Figure

skills.detail:
Puts the character in Sparking state.
While he is in Sparking state, the power of his Normal Attacks increases, he cannot be Staggered, and he gains Status Effect Nullification.
Deals a close-range attack while the skill button is held down.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

Deals a long-range multiple hit area attack after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Attack partially ignores obstacles.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Sparking Valkyrie
